rows.label: Ireland
rows.description: island in the North Atlantic Ocean
rows.hook: is famous for lush green landscapes, castles and folklore about leprechauns

rows.label: Great Britain
rows.description: island in the North Atlantic Ocean off the northwest coast of continental Europe
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben, Stonehenge and rolling green countryside

rows.label: Borneo
rows.description: third largest island in the world by area, located in south-east Asia
rows.hook: is covered in ancient rainforest that's home to orangutans

rows.label: New Guinea
rows.description: island in the Pacific Ocean
rows.hook: is home to more distinct languages than anywhere else on Earth

rows.label: Java
rows.description: island of Indonesia
rows.hook: is one of the most densely populated places on Earth and holds a nation's capital

rows.label: Hispaniola
rows.description: island in the Caribbean
rows.hook: is shared by two very different nations across a mountainous border

rows.label: Sakhalin
rows.description: large Russian island in the North Pacific Ocean
rows.hook: lies just north of Japan and is rich in oil and natural gas

rows.label: Sumatra
rows.description: island in western Indonesia, westernmost of the Sunda Islands
rows.hook: is home to endangered tigers and rows of active volcanoes

rows.label: Newfoundland
rows.description: island portion of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
rows.hook: was one of the first parts of North America reached by Norse explorers

rows.label: Kyushu
rows.description: third largest island of Japan
rows.hook: is dotted with active volcanoes and hot spring resorts

rows.label: Vancouver Island
rows.description: island of British Columbia, Canada
rows.hook: is known for its rugged coastline, rainforests and whale watching

rows.label: Mindanao
rows.description: second largest island of the Philippines
rows.hook: is home to indigenous highland tribes and rich biodiversity

rows.label: Baffin Island
rows.description: largest Arctic island in Nunavut, Canada
rows.hook: is a vast, icy Arctic wilderness home to polar bears and narwhals

rows.label: Sulawesi
rows.description: one of the four Greater Sunda Islands, governed by Indonesia
rows.hook: has a distinctive branching shape unlike any other island

rows.label: Cape Breton Island
rows.description: island in Nova Scotia, Canada
rows.hook: is famous for its dramatic coastal highlands and Celtic music heritage

rows.label: Shikoku
rows.description: fourth largest island of Japan
rows.hook: is famous for an ancient Buddhist pilgrimage route linking many temples

rows.label: Luzon
rows.description: largest island of the Philippines
rows.hook: is the largest island of its archipelago and holds its bustling capital

rows.label: Ellesmere Island
rows.description: part of the Qikiqtaaluk Region of the Canadian territory of Nunavut
rows.hook: is one of the most remote, ice-covered lands in the high Arctic

rows.label: South Island
rows.description: one of the two main New Zealand islands
rows.hook: is famous for its snow-capped peaks, glaciers and fjords

rows.label: Spitsbergen
rows.description: largest island of the Svalbard archipelago in northern Norway
rows.hook: is a remote Arctic archipelago home to more polar bears than people
